caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Textile Workers Union
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Textile Workers Union of America, CIO
attorneys: Solicitor General Rankin, Theophil C. Kammholz and Dominick L. Manoli for petitioner. Arthur J. Goldberg, David E. Feller and Benjamin Wyle for the Textile Workers Union of America et al., respondents.

opinions.text: The order entered April 2, 1956, 350 U. S. 1004, granting petition for writ of certiorari is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit is denied.
